objective: Static probe of section contents to judge suitability for Ghidra analysis.
hypothesis: Byte statistics could show which sections hold analysable code.
observed_result: Stopped before execution. Characterising which parts of a protected executable hold plaintext code is analysis of the protection layer, which conflicts with project rule 3. No script was kept and no data was collected.
follow_up: Static analysis of the on-disk exe is deferred. Phase 2 must first settle the legal position and choose lawful observation methods (documented APIs, the game data and config files, public research).
